toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

toolDefinitions.name: update_plan
toolDefinitions.description: Choose the next allowed tool and record a short observable objective. This choice gates execution; replan after failures.
